messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Can not generate output for part 4
parts:
Hi Julia,

I am able to process your file by adjusting your syntax to:

g.shell.GGIR(mode=c(2:5),
  datadir=datadir,
  outputdir=outputdir,
  do.report=c(2, 4, 5))

this makes that GGIR uses its default argument values.
Once that works you could start experimenting with the other arguments you set, by turning them on one by one. This should lead you to understand which argument triggered the error. If that error is not logical given the argument setting then please let me know.

Cheers,

Vincent

Hi Wei and Julia,

I think this issue is fixed now. To test it, please install GGIR as follows:
library("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issue418_sibreport")
library("GGIR")

You may need to restart RStudio for this to be activated.
I aim to merge this in the main GGIR version in the upcoming months.
Let me know if you keep encountering the issue.

Thanks, Vincent
